source_schema.claim: Concise statement supported by this source for the assessed dimension

budget.low: Common reagents and routine operations; low expected cost burden at the stated scale
budget.medium: One or more specialized or moderately costly items
budget.high: Multiple costly, scarce, or specialized items
budget.unknown: Scale or price evidence is insufficient

procurement_difficulty.low: Routine catalog availability from multiple suppliers
procurement_difficulty.medium: Specialized item; stock or lead time requires confirmation
procurement_difficulty.high: Custom synthesis, limited sources, or likely long lead time
procurement_difficulty.unknown: Identity, availability, or lead time cannot be established

hazard.low: No material issue identified beyond routine laboratory controls
hazard.medium: Additional containment, inert handling, or controlled addition may be required
hazard.high: Serious toxicity, reactivity, flammability, pressure, or process-hazard concern

operational_complexity.low: Routine apparatus, addition, work-up, and isolation
operational_complexity.medium: Requires inert atmosphere, controlled temperature, or additional handling steps
operational_complexity.high: Narrow operating window or complex addition, monitoring, work-up, or isolation

scale_up_risk.low: No material heat-transfer, mass-transfer, gas, or pressure concern identified
scale_up_risk.medium: One or more scale-dependent factors require experimental confirmation
scale_up_risk.high: Material exotherm, gas evolution, pressure, mixing, or heat-removal concern

waste_disposal_burden.low: Compatible with established routine waste streams
waste_disposal_burden.medium: Requires segregated collection or specialized treatment
waste_disposal_burden.high: High-hazard, metal-containing, reactive, or otherwise difficult waste stream
waste_disposal_burden.unknown: The disposal route cannot be established

scoring_policy.unknown_handling: If any dimension is unknown, feasibility_total_score is null and score_coverage is reported
scoring_policy.interpretation: The score summarizes feasibility evidence and does not create or modify an optimizer ranking

safety_gate_policy.blocked_when: critical_safety_flags is non-empty, or hazard or scale_up_risk is high
safety_gate_policy.conditional_when: not blocked and any dimension is unknown, waste_disposal_burden is high, or safety-relevant evidence is not verified
safety_gate_policy.eligible_when: all dimensions are known, neither hazard nor scale_up_risk is high, waste_disposal_burden is not high, and safety-relevant evidence is verified
safety_gate_policy.selection_rule: A blocked condition cannot be selected; if all five conditions are blocked, return no_condition_recommended
safety_gate_policy.approval_boundary: eligible does not replace current SDS, laboratory SOP, or EHS review

operational_complexity.rationale: Concise apparatus, control, work-up, and isolation rationale

scale_up_risk.rationale: Concise heat, mass-transfer, gas, pressure, and mixing rationale

waste_disposal_burden.rationale: Concise waste segregation and disposal rationale

candidate_assessments.candidate_summary: One or two sentences stating the main practical advantage, limitation, and evidence basis

program_computed_output.feasibility_total_score: Integer from 6 to 18 when complete; otherwise null

final_recommendations.rationale: Why this queried Top-5 condition has the best practical balance, including comparison with optimizer rank 1
tradeoffs: Explicit practical benefit and corresponding numerical or operational cost
final_recommendations.alternative_rationale: Why the alternative is useful, or why no safe alternative is available
unresolved_information: Current price, stock, SDS, process-safety, or waste information still requiring verification
required_checks: Verify current supplier availability, quotation, and lead time
Review current SDS and laboratory SOP
Confirm scale-up controls and waste-disposal route
